headline: What DBS Bank’s CEO transition says about building successors
summary: Effective CEO succession planning requires years of deliberate cross-functional exposure rather than simply identifying candidates late in a transition process. Drawing on lessons from DBS Bank, industry experts emphasize that cultivating internal leadership depth reduces an organization's reliance on external executive hiring. Ultimately, strong succession strategies focus on actively developing future leaders through structured development rather than mere talent identification.

headline: Ford Motor Company appoints Samir Singh as director, talent acquisition – APAC
summary: Ford Motor Company has appointed Samir Singh as Director of Talent Acquisition for the Asia-Pacific (APAC) region, effective July 2026. In his new role, Singh will drive regional talent acquisition strategies focused on AI-enabled innovation, data-driven decision making, and future-ready capabilities. He brings extensive recruitment leadership experience from previous roles at major companies including Verizon, Amazon Web Services, Deloitte, and Dell.

headline: Turtlemint appoints Monica Anshul Mishra as CHRO
summary: Turtlemint Fintech Solutions has appointed Monica Anshul Mishra as its Chief Human Resources Officer to strengthen its leadership team and people-first strategy as the company scales. Mishra brings extensive executive HR experience from previous roles at Fibe, Yes Bank, and Reliance Retail. In her new role, she will focus on talent architecture, leadership development, and building a high-performance culture to support Turtlemint's growth.

headline: Guidewire appoints Sharon Narang to lead people function for India and APAC product development
summary: Enterprise software firm Guidewire has appointed Sharon Narang as its people leader for India and APAC product development. Based in Bengaluru, Narang will focus on driving capability growth, workforce engagement, and career development across regional product teams. She brings extensive HR leadership experience from previous roles at major organizations including Wibmo, Flipkart, Deloitte, and Microsoft.

headline: US layoffs remain muted as weekly jobless claims edge down to 2,06,000
summary: US initial jobless claims marginally declined to 206,000, signaling that employers are largely avoiding layoffs and maintaining labor market stability. Recent payroll data also showed robust job additions in August, reinforcing strong staff retention across sectors. However, unemployed individuals continue to face extended job searches, as the median duration of unemployment remains near a 4.5-year high.

headline: Mumbai conference to accelerate digital welfare delivery for construction workers
summary: India's Ministry of Labour & Employment and the Government of Maharashtra are hosting a national conference in Mumbai to fast-track digital welfare initiatives for construction workers. Nine states and union territories will introduce digital reforms, including job-matching portals, physical facilitation centers, and online cess collection systems. These measures aim to eliminate intermediaries, enhance transparency, and streamline welfare delivery for millions of workers nationwide.

headline: Marriott International launches Project Prarambh to skill 500 youth for hospitality careers
summary: Marriott International has launched Project Prarambh, an initiative aimed at skilling 500 young people from vulnerable communities across India for careers in hospitality over the next two to three years. In collaboration with The Job Plus and the Tourism & Hospitality Skill Council, the programme provides industry-aligned training, mentorship, and practical exposure to help participants transition into formal employment. The project seeks to address the sector's demand for skilled talent while creating long-term career pathways for youth.

headline: V2 Retail opens 24 stores in August, adds nearly 1,000 jobs across 11 states
summary: V2 Retail expanded its network by opening a record 24 new stores across 11 states in August 2026, bringing its total location count past 415. The expansion targets a mix of smaller Tier-II to Tier-IV markets alongside major cities, adding nearly 200,000 square feet of retail space and 960 direct jobs. Funded entirely through internal accruals without equity dilution, the retailer remains on track to open up to 200 stores this fiscal year.

headline: Why succession planning is no longer replacement planning
summary: Modern succession planning is shifting away from simply identifying direct replacements to preparing organizations for evolving business landscapes. Atul Mathur of Aditya Birla Capital emphasizes that future leaders require learning agility and broad experience rather than just traditional tenure. Consequently, effective succession strategies must focus on equipping leaders to navigate rapid technological, regulatory, and market changes.

headline: Singapore PM’s pay rise sparks debate
summary: Singapore's Prime Minister Lawrence Wong will see his annual salary rise to S$3.6 million, cementing his position as the world's highest-paid leader and reigniting public debate over ministerial compensation. The government argues high pay attracts top talent and prevents corruption, while critics highlight the stark contrast with ordinary citizens facing rising living costs. In response to the backlash, Wong announced he will donate the entire pay increase to charity over the next five years.

headline: The career decisions employees shouldn’t make in a hurry
summary: HR leaders caution professionals against making hasty career moves driven by social comparisons, artificial urgency, or superficial perks like higher salaries and titles. Instead, employees should conduct thorough due diligence on an organization's culture, growth potential, and personal long-term goals before accepting a new role. Evaluating genuine personal priorities ensures that career transitions lead to long-term satisfaction rather than temporary fixes.

headline: Rising Star: Gaurav Modak
summary: Gaurav Modak was awarded the Rewards Guru title at the HRKatha Rising Star Leadership Awards 2025 for his work in compensation, performance, and incentive design. He emphasizes that successful incentive plans require stakeholder involvement and buy-in rather than just logical structure, advocating for incentive frameworks that directly align employee behavior with strategic priorities. Additionally, Modak focuses on balancing leadership goals with employee needs by making implicit trade-offs explicit.

headline: Grace period cut threatens worker security, H1B visa holders worried
summary: A proposed rule by the U.S. Department of Homeland Security aims to eliminate the 60-day grace period currently granted to foreign visa holders, such as H-1B workers, following job loss. Under the change, terminated employees would be forced to leave the country immediately rather than having time to seek new U.S. employment. The move could destabilize the skilled workforce, increase logistical burdens for employers, and weaken overall U.S. competitiveness.

headline: Dilip Sinha joins Super Smelters as president & CHRO
summary: Dilip Sinha has been appointed as the President and Chief Human Resources Officer at Indian steel manufacturer Super Smelters. He joins the company following his most recent role as President and CHRO at Jindal Steel & Power. Sinha brings extensive HR leadership experience from previous executive roles at companies including Vedanta Aluminium Metal, JSW Steel, and Reliance Retail.

headline: Arun Nair is now VP-HR, IKS Health
summary: Arun Nair has rejoined IKS Health as Vice President of Human Resources, where he will lead HR for the company's Ambulatory Business Unit. This marks his third tenure with the healthcare technology provider, following previous leadership roles in talent acquisition. Prior to this appointment, Nair served as the head of global talent acquisition and retention at Rubicon Research.

headline: Mint Money unveils its app with Bill Payments at Global Fintech Fest 2026
summary: Mint Money, the fintech platform by HT Media Group, launched a new Bill Payments feature powered by NBBL's Bharat Connect at the Global Fintech Fest 2026. The update integrates utility payments, auto-pay, and rewards directly alongside the app's existing financial content, credit tools, and AI coaching. By pairing transaction capabilities with guidance, Mint Money aims to simplify everyday financial management for consumers across India.

headline: LUX Champion tackles ‘gili chaddi’ woes with a cheeky campaign
summary: Innerwear brand LUX Champion has launched its #SayNoToGiliChaddi campaign to address the common monsoon issue of slow-drying underwear. The marketing push highlights a functional product benefit, claiming that its Stretch Collection dries up to five times faster than traditional innerwear. By focusing on practical performance over conventional themes like fit and fabric, the brand aims to differentiate its product offering.

headline: Ulka South appoints Siddharth Mehta as Group Creative Director
summary: Ulka, a part of BBDO Group India, has appointed Siddharth Mehta as its new Group Creative Director to strengthen its creative leadership. Mehta brings over 15 years of industry experience across mainline, digital, and creative-tech environments from prior roles at agencies including The Womb, Leo Burnett, and JWT. In his new position, he will report to Chief Creative Officer Rakesh Menon and focus on developing bold, culturally relevant campaigns.

headline: Advertising Club Madras re-elects Surej Salim as president
summary: Surej Salim, co-founder and COO of Digitally Inspired Media, has been re-elected as the president of Advertising Club Madras for the 2026-27 term. The announcement was made alongside the election of the broader leadership team at the club's annual general meeting. The organization continues to oversee major industry initiatives, including the MADDYS awards, youth mentoring, and specialized educational programs.

source_publication: Transportation | Logistics | Aviation | Shipping | Supply Chain

Funded entirely through internal accruals, the vessel is scheduled to join the company's fleet in Q3 FY27. The transaction follows several recent vessel acquisitions by GE Shipping, which currently operates a 40-vessel fleet at near 100% utilization.
